content: ESP32 serving gzipped JS/CSS from PROGMEM: gzip assets offline (gzip -9), convert to C byte array in PROGMEM header, serve with Content-Encoding: gzip header + correct MIME (application/javascript / text/css). Classic WebServer pattern: server.sendHeader("Content-Encoding","gzip"); server.setContentLength(len); server.send(200,mime,""); server.sendContent((const char*)data,len). This exact binary-serve shape is already proven in this codebase (main_basestation.cpp thumbnail route). Add Cache-Control so the ~46KB Leaflet payload is fetched once. References: esp32.com forum t=4708, mischianti.org byte-array gzipped pages tutorial, techtutorialsx ESP32 serving jQuery.
